title: 1st special sitting of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamdu and Salawat) as the sitting begins.
Announcement of the day's agenda (agenda no. AJ/20/2026/KS/1).
From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for President of the Human Rights Commission (Act No. 6/2006, s.8(b)) is sent to the relevant standing committee.
First reading of the bill amending the Maldives Penal Code (Law No. 9/2014), submitted on behalf of the government by Ahmed Azaan Mirzooq, MP for Hithadhoo Central.
First reading of the bill amending the Maldives Pension Act (Law No. 8/2009), submitted on behalf of the government by Hassan Mufeed Abdul Qadir, MP for Milandhoo.
First reading of the bill amending the Constitution of the Maldives, submitted on behalf of the government by Ibrahim Falah, MP for Inguraidhoo.
Preliminary debate on the bill amending the Maldives Penal Code (Law No. 9/2014), submitted on behalf of the government by Ahmed Azaan Mirzooq, MP for Hithadhoo Central.
Preliminary debate on the bill amending the Maldives Pension Act (Law No. 8/2009), submitted on behalf of the government by Hassan Mufeed Abdul Qadir, MP for Milandhoo.
Preliminary debate on the bill amending the Constitution of the Maldives, submitted on behalf of the government by Ibrahim Falah, MP for Inguraidhoo.
National Development and Heritage Committee report on its review of the Re-employment Bill.
Votes on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: A special sitting during the recess where the government introduced and opened debate on changes to the Penal Code, the Pension Act and the Constitution, and sent its Human Rights Commission nominee to committee.
